lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered matrix of circular high-luminance centroids arranged in approximately 6 horizontal rows and 12-14 vertical columns posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a distinct grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank; the primary ridge exhibits a sharp intensity gradient transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: First dorsal fin contains approximately 18-22 high-luminance blobs of varying size, with higher spatial density observed near the base and posterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible irregular notch on the trailing edge of the left pectoral fin, located approximately one-third of the distance from the distal tip toward the base.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) visible beneath the pectoral fin and along the ventral-lateral midline.
